name: TaskManager App Sidebar Navigation Plan
description: Verifies that clicking each sidebar item successfully switches the active viewport and displays the relevant telemetry.

planSteps.description: Assert that the default tab is the 'Overview' dashboard displaying CPU and Memory meters
Click the 'Processes' item in the sidebar navigation
Assert that the process list table is populated and groups processes into Apps, Background, and System categories
Click the 'App History' item in the sidebar navigation
Assert that the list displays historical CPU and network metrics per application
Click the 'Startup Apps' item in the sidebar navigation
Assert that the startup items are resolved from native macOS launch services
Click the 'Services' item in the sidebar
Assert that the launchd services table is visible
Click the 'Insights & Diagnostics' item in the sidebar
Assert that the System Bottlenecks description, Storage grow tracker, and network connections are active
